title: Supreme Court removes litigant from courtroom after he hurls abuses at judges, flings documents
description: A litigant had to be forcibly removed from the Supreme Court on Friday after he hurled abuses in court and documents during the hearing of his petition challenging a decision of the Allahabad High Court.The development took place before a Bench of Justice KV Viswanathan and Justice Alok Aradhe.The courtroom atmosphere turned dramatic when the petitioner, who appeared in person, displayed an unusually aggressive stance in his submissions."Mr judicial servant.
